entities.summary: Tomas Alenčikas, known by his stage name Lion Ceccah and previously as Alen Chicco, is a Lithuanian singer-songwriter. He is set to represent Lithuania in the Eurovision Song Contest 2026 with his song "Sólo quiero más".
